optimizer: Fresh Adam identically for all four arms; same warm checkpoint, no optimizer-state continuation claim.
loss: Unchanged focal plus5*L1 plus2*GIoU; sparse reviewed supervision only.
selection: Fixed final epoch160 for both arms and both seeds. No best-epoch, confidence or proposal-threshold selection.
data: Original129 scenes plus27 sparse supervised TRAIN scenes (23 reviewed blue boxes plus reviewed real clutter). Controls repeat27 deterministic original FIT scenes. Original16 grouped holdout scenes untouched; no IMG-family training.
training_gate: Both admission seeds must increase known blue proposal coverage on new positive TRAIN scenes over the warm parent, retain original FIT red and blue coverage, and reduce mean blue heat on new negative-only reviewed cells. evaluation: Export and development evaluation only after the paired TRAIN gate. Preserve classifier and search thresholds; no Pi deployment or flight claim.
